details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:44-45,57-112 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The fallback budget-state helper keys its `/tmp` file by `$$`, so concurrent judge invocations can share or collide on the same budget state.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged cross-pollination risk in the shared-budget tracker, even though it noted the current workflow usually runs one judge per PR at a time.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:57-114 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_embed_input_file` accepts `_mode` but only implements head-mode truncation, so a diff-mode call would be handled as head mode.
  WHY: Both reviewers noted the parameter is vestigial in current callers and would silently misbehave if reused for diffs.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:91-92 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The truncation-marker `printf` uses `%s` placeholders with mode/cap/budget values that could be interpreted as format directives.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this is safe with current numeric/literal callers but would be fragile if a future caller supplied percent-bearing text.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:685-688 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The prompt-size logging is guarded so it only logs once even if later retries change the prompt after sanitization.
  WHY: The reviewer said later retries can hide prompt-size changes in the log.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:401-412 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: PR_DIFF truncation aborts if `python3` is unavailable because there is no simpler fallback.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, a missing interpreter stops the script instead of degrading to byte truncation.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-111,447 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The EXIT trap can call `_cleanup_prompt_budget` when that function was never defined.
  WHY: The reviewer said that if `gh_helpers.sh` provides `_embed_input_file`, the fallback block is skipped and the trap later hits an undefined command under `set -euo pipefail`.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:89 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: If the Python truncator fails, the `head -c` fallback can split a multibyte UTF-8 sequence.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that the prompt can end up with invalid UTF-8 in the Codex input path.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:376-395 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The inline `printf | python3` truncation path for `PR_DIFF` is fragile on very large diffs or shell-metacharacter-laden content.
  WHY: The reviewer said it can leave `PR_DIFF` empty or cut mid-hunk, so decisions may use incomplete change context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:682-696 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A failed `wc -c` leaves `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_BYTES` empty, and the `-gt 950000` check then treats it as zero and suppresses the warning.
  WHY: The reviewer said the added diagnostic can disappear on platforms where `wc` misbehaves, hiding envelope overflows.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-78,450 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `/tmp/_prompt_input_budget_state.$$` file is updated without locking, so stale budget state can leak across runs.
  WHY: The reviewer said parallel runs or non-EXIT failures can leave the budget exhausted for later judge executions.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:464-515 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A present-but-empty `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` can leave the requirement file effectively blank without emitting the fallback note.
  WHY: The reviewer said the judge then receives a nearly empty requirement section instead of the PR title/body context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:37-114 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The script duplicates the canonical `_embed_input_file`/budget helpers and still has a stale “repo var” comment.
  WHY: The reviewer said this risks future divergence from `gh_helpers.sh` and mismatched documentation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
